title: Establishment of the N1 NAS signalling connection

entities.name: N1 NAS signalling connection establishment
entities.description: Procedure for establishing N1 NAS signalling connection when UE needs to transmit initial NAS messages. Involves requesting RRC connection establishment and transitioning to 5GMM-CONNECTED mode.

entities.name: 5GMM-IDLE mode
entities.description: UE state where no NAS signalling connection exists. UE transitions from this state to 5GMM-CONNECTED when N1 connection is established.

entities.name: 5GMM-CONNECTED mode
entities.description: UE state where N1 NAS signalling connection is established. UE enters this state after successful connection establishment.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST message
entities.description: Initial NAS message used for registration procedures. Triggers N1 connection establishment.

entities.name: DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message
entities.description: Initial NAS message used for deregistration procedures. Triggers N1 connection establishment.

entities.name: SERVICE REQUEST message
entities.description: Initial NAS message used for service request procedures. Triggers N1 connection establishment.

entities.name: CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: Initial NAS message used for control plane service requests. Triggers N1 connection establishment.

entities.name: 5G-GUTI
entities.description: 5G Globally Unique Temporary Identifier used for UE identification. Provided to lower layers for routing in certain conditions.

entities.name: 4G-GUTI
entities.description: 4G Globally Unique Temporary Identifier used for UE identification in EPS. Can be mapped to 5G-GUTI for inter-system changes.

entities.name: 5G-S-TMSI
entities.description: 5G Short Temporary Mobile Subscriber Identity used for UE identification. Provided to lower layers for routing in certain conditions.

entities.name: GUAMI
entities.description: Globally Unique AMF Identifier used for AMF identification and routing. Provided to lower layers in various scenarios.

entities.name: SUCI
entities.description: Subscription Concealed Identifier used for privacy protection. Provided to lower layers when no GUTI is available.

entities.name: Tracking area in registration area
entities.description: Condition where current cell's tracking area is within UE's registration area. Determines which identifier to provide to lower layers.

entities.name: Provide identity to lower layers
entities.description: UE NAS behavior of providing UE identity information to lower layers for routing and connection establishment.

relations.description: N1 connection establishment procedure requires UE to be in 5GMM-IDLE mode initially
Successful N1 connection establishment results in UE entering 5GMM-CONNECTED mode
Registration Request message triggers N1 connection establishment procedure
Deregistration Request message triggers N1 connection establishment procedure
Service Request message triggers N1 connection establishment procedure
Control Plane Service Request message triggers N1 connection establishment procedure
Condition of tracking area being in registration area determines which identity is provided to lower layers
UE NAS provides 5G-S-TMSI to lower layers when tracking area is in registration area
UE NAS provides GUAMI to lower layers when tracking area is not in registration area
UE NAS provides SUCI to lower layers when no GUTI is available on trusted non-3GPP access
